The '''Unis Islands''' were a remote set of islands on [[Kaal/Legends|Kaal]]. [[Jeng Droga]] crashed [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] yacht near the islands in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]] after becoming possessed by Palpatine's spirit in the aftermath of his death. Droga lived on the islands for a brief period before [[Sate Pestage/Legends|Sate Pestage]] recovered him.
